method: Pinned JS release builds on one machine. Ordinary: three process pairs with three warmups and nine 500-call samples per process. Deep: four process pairs with three warmups and nine 16-call samples per process. CLI: two warmup pairs and nine measured pairs with byte comparisons, startup and peak RSS. Each candidate is run in both initial process orders. The control uses one identical binary on both sides. Negative percentages indicate lower elapsed time.

endpointProbe.method: Instrumentation only counts or times name-index lookups made from resource-order branches. A WeakMap keyed by the per-plan index counts the first lookup of each name. Counts and timers ran in separate processes. The timing-only control brackets an empty interval before the same call. Samples include warmups and budget checks.
